text:
oliver: Flagging a weird billing diff — several high-throughput routes show project=null while sa is present. Customers reported unexpected spikes.

priya: I saw that too. Reproducer points to token-exchange proxy which strips x-project on the fast-fail code path.

marco: That fast-fail was added to avoid blocking on identity lookups during bursts. It only returns sa_id+scopes.

infra-bot: deploy: token-exchange-proxy v1.7.9 -> canary at 2024-09-04T14:12:00Z

jen: UX note — console treats project=null as "unattributed" and attributes to org or unknown. That skews per-project quotas.

ops: Changing proxy to synchronously fetch project will add latency. Need cost/latency tradeoff analysis.

priya: Proposal: emit an "attribution_provenance" enum and small hint flags from the proxy: provenance=CLAIMED | HINTED | UNKNOWN, and had_sa_project_hint=true/false. Keep actual project id out of hot path telemetry to avoid explosion.

oliver: Console can then show an "attribution provenance" column and a confidence pill. Good for transparency.

marco: Implementation: add a tiny in-proxy cache for SA->project (ttl 3m) with async backfill. On fast-fail path, set provenance=HINTED if cache hit else UNKNOWN.

ops: Add circuit-breakers: if async backfill queue length > 50k or identity error rate > 3% for 10m, disable hints. Emit metric provenance_hint_on_ratio.

jen: Rollout suggestion: default off, enable internally, then pilot with 5 customers, then opt-in toggle in console with clear banner about possible number differences.

console-bot: feature request logged: CONSOLE-1601 "show attribution provenance + confidence"

priya: Minimal telemetry sample to emit: "req_id, service_account, provenance:HINTED, had_sa_project_hint:true" (no project id). Console maps HINTED to inferred project only in UI.

marco: I'll open a small RFC and PR. Need identity team's async lookup API to support batched backfills.

ops: I'll prepare cost/ingest numbers for SRE review. Include storage delta and ingest rate. If delta > 1.7x auto-disable.

oliver: Owners: Oliver (product), Priya (proxy change + RFC), Marco (cache impl), Jen (console copy), Ops (SRE). Sync 10am PT tomorrow to approve PR.

priya: Created ticket INFRA-3333 "proxy: attribution_provenance + sa->project hint"

oliver: Thanks, closing loop here.
